description: Fixed synthetic code and non-code retrieval cases with one semantic hard negative per case. Each query has one relevant file.

cases.meaning: Reject additional retries when the total elapsed request duration reaches the deadline.
cases.query: stop the entire sequence once its overall time allowance expires
cases.negative: Return whether a single network attempt timed out.

cases.meaning: Compute exponential backoff between successive failed requests.
cases.query: increase waiting time after each temporary connection failure
cases.negative: Delay a scheduled job until its calendar start time.

cases.meaning: Discard cached entries whose expiration timestamp has passed.
cases.query: remove stored responses that are too old to reuse
cases.negative: Refresh the authentication token before expiry.

cases.meaning: Keep only one item for each stable identifier in a collection.
cases.query: eliminate repeated records using their unique key
cases.negative: Generate a unique identifier for a new record.

cases.meaning: Abort outstanding work when a cancellation signal is received.
cases.query: stop unfinished operations when the caller withdraws the request
cases.negative: Cancel an email subscription for an account.

cases.meaning: Reject source intervals that extend beyond file boundaries.
cases.query: prevent reading line numbers outside the source document
cases.negative: Validate that a numeric input is within a business price range.

cases.meaning: Answer directly and include only information needed to satisfy the request.
cases.query: avoid repeating the question and keep introductory text brief
cases.negative: Always include a detailed introduction in an educational essay.

cases.meaning: Preserve unrelated uncommitted changes when editing the repository.
cases.query: leave existing user edits intact during implementation
cases.negative: Commit every changed file before switching branches.

cases.meaning: Search existing concepts and prefer extending their behavior before adding new concepts.
cases.query: look for prior solutions before introducing another abstraction
cases.negative: Always create a fresh component for every incoming requirement.

cases.meaning: Use a separate reviewer to assess the implementation evidence.
cases.query: have someone outside the implementation process check the changes
cases.negative: The implementer can run unit tests during development.

cases.meaning: Verify the repository snapshot before returning evidence from indexed source.
cases.query: ensure cached findings still correspond to current files
cases.negative: Use the current date in every report header.

cases.meaning: Ask for missing facts only when they materially affect the next decision.
cases.query: avoid repeated confirmation for actions already authorized
cases.negative: Ask every user to fill out an onboarding survey.

cases.meaning: After the initial asset download, cached model inference runs locally without a network connection.
cases.query: can analysis operate while the computer is disconnected
cases.negative: Cloud inference sends each request to a remote service.

cases.meaning: After an interrupted operation, the previous complete generation remains available.
cases.query: recover from a crash without losing the last successful index
cases.negative: Delete all previous generations before starting a new index.

cases.meaning: Pass the returned revision when updating an artifact to reject concurrent changes.
cases.query: avoid overwriting edits made after the file was read
cases.negative: The product version is shown on the about page.

cases.meaning: Document links and configuration references have distinct relationship types from code calls.
cases.query: how does the graph represent non-code connections
cases.negative: Function callers and callees are shown in code dependency diagrams.

cases.meaning: Repository content stays on the local machine during embedding inference.
cases.query: does semantic search upload project source to a service
cases.negative: Downloading runtime assets requires internet access on first use.

cases.meaning: A cold request returns a preparation identifier while indexing continues in the background.
cases.query: how can a caller check a long running first search
cases.negative: Search results can be sorted alphabetically after indexing.

cases.meaning: Maximum elapsed time across all retry attempts.
cases.query: cap the duration of an entire retry sequence
cases.negative: Maximum wait for one request attempt.

cases.meaning: Release the inference worker after this period with no active requests.
cases.query: stop the helper after it has been unused for a while
cases.negative: Maximum time to wait for a remote HTTP response.

cases.meaning: Maximum aggregate size of all source files captured in one snapshot.
cases.query: limit the complete repository input size
cases.negative: Maximum size of one individual source file.

cases.meaning: Number of CPU threads used inside one model inference operation.
cases.query: restrict processor parallelism for embedding execution
cases.negative: Maximum number of external review agents.

cases.meaning: Immutable commit identifier of the embedding model weights and tokenizer.
cases.query: pin a specific trained model rather than its moving latest version
cases.negative: Version string displayed for the plugin release.

cases.meaning: Maximum number of concept candidates returned by one search call.
cases.query: bound the size of a concept search response
cases.negative: Maximum number of source files admitted to the repository snapshot.
